comps.name: AD Flex
comps.economy_plan: Keep econ healthy, play strongest board, and look for a 4-cost AD carry on level 8.

leveling_plan.2: Play upgraded frontline plus any item holder.
leveling_plan.3: Push tempo if winstreaking; otherwise keep pairs and econ.
leveling_plan.4: Roll only to stabilize if HP is low, then go level 8 for carry upgrades.

notes: Prioritize a real frontline before adding extra backline damage.
Good when early components are Sword, Bow, Glove, or Cloak.

comps.name: AP Flex
comps.economy_plan: Stabilize with upgraded casters, then push level 8 for higher-cost AP upgrades.

leveling_plan.2: Use any upgraded caster or ranged holder with a small frontline.
leveling_plan.3: Prefer AP item holders and protect HP.
leveling_plan.4: Roll for upgraded AP carry/frontline only if the board is losing hard.

notes: Stronger when you already have Tear/Rod starts.
Avoid tunneling if the shop gives mostly AD pairs.

comps.name: Frontline Stabilize
comps.economy_plan: Buy frontline pairs and preserve HP while waiting for a clearer carry direction.

leveling_plan.2: Make upgraded frontline and avoid bleeding too much HP.
leveling_plan.3: Hold flexible carries while using tank items immediately.
leveling_plan.4: Pivot once items or shop clearly point to AD/AP.

notes: This is a bridge line, not the final cap.
Useful when items and shops disagree.
